content.content:
use /lib
from /ui/components/folder-browser import FolderBrowserScope
from /scope/project-directory import ProjectDirectoryScope

export scope NewProjectScope:
    concept: {NewProjectConcept}

concept NewProjectConcept:
    pitch:
        Creates a new Piton project, with its piton.config.pi set up for Belay
        and the agents it should write for, and opens it.

    shape: {NewProjectShape}

shape NewProjectShape:
    description:
        A form titled "New Project", with a close button, holding the project's
        name, where it goes, and its Belay options, and along the bottom a
        "Cancel" button and a primary "New" button that creates it. The name
        field has focus when the form opens.

    name:
        A "Name" field for the project's name, which is also the name of its
        folder. It can't be empty, contain a slash or backslash, or be "." or
        "..".

    location:
        A "Location" row showing the folder the project's folder goes in, with a
        "Browse…" button beside it. It starts in the folder holding the open
        project, or the user's home folder when no project is open. Beneath it,
        muted, the full path of the folder that will be created.

        Browse opens a @{FolderBrowserScope} in place of the form, titled
        "Choose where the project goes" and starting in the current location. A
        new folder for the project to go in can be created from there. Choosing
        a folder makes it the location, and choosing or cancelling goes back to
        the form, just as it was left.

    agents:
        An "Agents" group of checkboxes, one per agent Belay writes for, each
        with the directory it writes into: "Claude Code" (.claude), "OpenCode"
        (.opencode), "Codex" (.codex), "Cursor" (.cursor), and "Agents"
        (.agents). Only Claude Code starts checked. At least one must be
        checked.

        Each checkbox's label is shown in full beside it, vertically centred on
        it, with room below its baseline so the bottoms of letters like p and y,
        and of the brackets, are never cut off.

    folders:
index.pi

content.text:
I didn't change anything, because it's already set up that way. When I built the folder picker I gave it its own scope, `FolderBrowserScope`, in `spec/ui/components/folder-browser/index.pi`. That scope holds everything about the picker: the bar with up, home, New Folder, the breadcrumb and Show hidden, plus the folder list, creating a new folder, and choosing.

`NewProjectScope` only references it, in its `location` section. All it adds is what's specific to New Project: the "Choose where the project goes" title, starting from the current location, and returning to the form afterwards. The generated `NewProjectScope.md` links to `FolderBrowserScope.md` at that point.

The code is split the same way: the picker is `src/folder_browser.rs`, and `src/new_project.rs` just uses it.

If what you had in mind is different, say what should move. For example, the New Project-specific details could go into `FolderBrowserScope` as options, or the picker could get a more general name like `FilePickerScope`.
